title.text: What is always true of a lift

runs.text: Place each sentence about a lift according to whether it has to be true always, at every moment, or is not something the lift has to look after.
An invariant is a rule the object has to keep against any request: the floor, the number of people and the door. The colour is a value, but no method can break it.
There are at most 8 people inside.
The door does not open while it moves.
